PreToolUse.description: Block creating NEW files in frozen zones (app/Services/, app/Http/Controllers/, routes/web/, routes/api/). Existing files (bug fix) are allowed.
Block direct `php artisan` calls. Project runs in Docker — use ./scripts/dev.sh artisan instead.

PostToolUse.description: Warn (non-blocking) when a PHP file uses response()->json() directly instead of ApiResponse::success() / ApiResponse::error().
